adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, new code unconditionally calls `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and then `prisma.credential.update(...)` before constructing the `jsforce.Connection`, with no expiry/need check shown. The file also does not use the newly introduced `refreshOAuthTokens` helper (it only imports `parseRefreshTokenResponse`). While the claim about how often the service is constructed can’t be verified from this diff alone, the diff-grounded concern about doing a network refresh + DB write on every connection initialization is real and can create unnecessary load and racey updates under concurrency.
